# Neon Scars Project Guardrails

## 🎭 Context & Lore
This project maps out a K-pop dark cyberpunk universe. The central narrative is a dramatic, high-stakes love triangle between an underground rebel and a cold, meticulous corporate CEO, both vying for the allegiance and survival of a rogue blonde nomad.

## 🛠️ Formatting Standards
* All lyrics files must prioritize side-by-side or alternating English and Romanized Korean (Hangeul translations optional).
* Maintain strict separation between visual storyboard markdown files and text track metadata.
